Sasha: hey — does anyone have the grafana board that combines model runbook + regional health? need to check after yesterday's eu deploy. bookmarks give me 403 :confused:
Anika: which workspace/org? eu-west or global?
Sasha: eu-west (orgId=8). used to be under Observability -> Model Health + Runbook tile. getting 403 when I click it.
Devon: might be a shortlink drift. try this (may be stale): https://grafana.redwood.dev/d/abc123/model-runbook?orgId=8  — if that 403s it's RBAC. pinged infra a sec ago.
Sasha: that 403 is consistent, even when opening incognito. any quick RBAC steps I can do?
Lee: you need the `observability-viewer` role in the eu org. people with `team-observability` should auto-get it.
Sasha: I don't see team-observability in my profile.
ops-bot: Maria requested: add Sasha to team-observability (eu) — approval needed.
Maria: adding now, give me a minute. (will add via infra console)
Maria: done — added Sasha -> observability-readers (eu). should prop within a minute.
Sasha: reloaded — access works! thanks :tada:
Sasha: quick follow-up — any pointers to traces/latency slices for model-inference in eu? want to inspect a few slow traces tied to that deploy.
Devon: for traces, use Tempo explore with a `service` filter. example Tempo url: https://tempo.redwood.dev/explore?query=service%3D%22model-inference%22&orgId=8
Devon: for logs, Loki query to surface slow responses (LogQL):
```
{job="model-inference", region="eu-west"} | json | duration_ms > 1500
```
Devon: that should give you logs correlated to slow traces; click the trace link in the log line to open Tempo.
Anika: FYI on alerts — the p95 latency alert for model-inference in eu has been noisy after the autoscaler tweak. I'm going to open a PR to adjust the alert window to 10m and bump threshold to 2s while we stabilize.
Sasha: great — can you tag the oncall when you do? @oncall-eng
Anika: will do.
Sasha: thanks everyone. saving the runbook link to my bookmarks now (works). :pray:
